items.title: Earnings: Beef prices weigh on Tyson Foods, McDonald's Q2 results on deck
items.summary: Enjoy your earnings season with a juicy side as Tyson Foods (TSN) cuts its annual profit outlook as rising beef prices weigh on US consumers.
